name: SiteOnAI Bio Card
author: kpauthorebox

sections.description:
SiteOnAI Bio Card helps site owners display a clean author bio/profile card before or after WordPress post and page content.

You can use default WordPress author data or create custom authors from the plugin admin panel. The plugin includes live preview, responsive layouts, shortcode support, Gutenberg blocks, author selection per post/page, design presets, import/export settings, and uninstall cleanup.

The plugin does not include telemetry, usage tracking, or remote API calls of its own. Plugin settings and custom author records are stored locally in the WordPress database. Custom author records may include administrator-entered names, biographies, email addresses, website URLs, avatar URLs, and social profile URLs. If your site displays WordPress avatars or you configure externally hosted avatar/profile URLs, visitor browsers may load those third-party resources.

Features

  • Display an author bio card before or after content.
  • Use WordPress author data or custom author data.
  • Create and manage multiple custom authors.
  • Select custom author(s) per post or page.
  • Live preview in admin settings.
  • Responsive frontend design.
  • Shortcodes: [siteonai_bio_card] and [siteonai_bio_card_list].
  • Gutenberg blocks for author card and author list.
  • Import/export settings.
  • Local default avatar asset included in the plugin.
  • No arbitrary custom CSS, JavaScript, PHP, or unsanitized HTML insertion feature.
  • No remote fallback image dependency.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the siteonai-bio-card folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or upload the ZIP from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate SiteOnAI Bio Card.
  3. Open WordPress Admin > SiteOnAI Bio Card and configure the display settings.
  4. Use automatic display or insert the shortcode [siteonai_bio_card].
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send data to external servers?

No. The plugin does not include telemetry, usage tracking, or remote API calls of its own. Plugin settings and custom author records are stored locally in the WordPress database. Custom author records may include administrator-entered names, biographies, email addresses, website URLs, avatar URLs, and social profile URLs. If your site displays WordPress avatars or you configure externally hosted avatar/profile URLs, visitor browsers may load those third-party resources.

Does this plugin store personal data?

If you create custom authors, the plugin stores the fields you enter, such as name, biography, email address, website URL, avatar URL, and social profile URLs, in the WordPress database. The plugin adds privacy policy guidance and supports WordPress personal data export/erase tools for custom authors by email address.

Does this plugin allow custom code insertion?

No. The plugin does not allow arbitrary custom CSS, JavaScript, or PHP insertion.

What happens on uninstall?

When the plugin is deleted from WordPress Admin, it removes plugin-owned settings, custom authors, backups, and post meta used for selected custom authors.

1.2.1

  • Added privacy policy guidance for site administrators.
  • Added WordPress personal data exporter and eraser support for custom authors by email address.
  • Improved import validation so numeric values follow the same bounds as the settings UI.
  • Implemented author-name linking settings and removed inactive archive/footer-display controls from the UI/defaults.
  • Improved frontend performance by loading frontend assets only when the bio card can display.
  • Added Domain Path header and improved JavaScript translation readiness.
  • Clarified readme privacy wording around local data storage and external avatar/profile URLs.

1.2.0

  • Added clear admin success, warning and error notices for settings saves, presets, setup, import, reset and author actions.
  • Added valid/invalid/empty JSON import feedback messages.
  • Updated plugin version after full manual testing.

1.0.5

  • Added manual hex code inputs next to color pickers for all color controls.
  • Kept color controls limited to solid hex colors only.

1.0.3

  • Fixed Appearance border style None so it removes the border/accent line.
  • Fixed Social icons type so Symbols and Colored background have distinct frontend styles.

1.0.2

  • Added stricter WordPress.org review readiness cleanup, plugin header metadata, readme sections, and removed unused custom HTML/tab settings.

1.0.1

  • Fixed plugin prefix consistency for WordPress.org review.

1.0

  • Initial release.
